title: Update on Review of Animals and Birds Act 1965 and Code of Animal Welfare
what_it_is: Update on Review of Animals and Birds Act 1965 and Code of Animal Welfare

sections.label: Review of animal cruelty penalties
sections.summary: The Animals and Birds Act penalty framework will be reviewed to deter and punish animal cruelty and abuse, with public and stakeholder engagement.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: For instance, the penalty framework under Animals and Birds Act will be reviewed to ensure that they are effective in deterring and punishing acts of animal cruelty and abuse.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: The review is wide-ranging and apart from reviewing penalties and enforcements, as I have just said, it also includes strengthening animal disease and zoonosis prevention and control, possible regulation of veterinary health products, as well as animal training devices, and other areas.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: We will continue to take a collaborative approach in this review and will engage the public and community stakeholders to ensure that their views are considered.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I note that NParks had shared publicly that they are reviewing the penalties for animal cruelty and animal abuse to ensure they are effective in deterring such acts, back in October 2021.

sections.label: Consultation on animal welfare issues
sections.summary: The review covers wider issues and will consult community, stakeholders, industry and professionals, including a dog training standards workgroup.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: So, it is looking not just at penalties, but also a wider range of issues as well.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We will consult the community, we will consult stakeholders, we will consult industry and professionals.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: For example, the Member will be aware that the dog training standards workgroup co-chaired by NParks and the Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals, involves representatives from animal welfare groups, dog trainers, vets and representatives from working dog units to study one specific area – that is on the least intrusive, minimally-averse training techniques, as well as to study and develop plans on the regulatory approaches to training devices.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: There are other work streams being undertaken involving consultation with different groups, but at a later stage, we will consult more widely.
